keepRegistryRecords.title: A new Library keeps records already held by the Registry.

previewWithoutWrites.title: Preview leaves the proposed Library sync unapplied.

refuseNewerFormat.title: Sync refuses a newer Registry format before uploading changes.

pullMissing.title: Sync pulls missing authored SKITs into this device without creating duplicate Collections.

propagateEdits.title: Sync propagates edits between connected Author Workspaces and refreshes enabled harnesses.

preserveWorkspaceFolders.title: Sync leaves occupied or deleted workspace folders alone and continues Library sync if a workspace is busy.

linkPulledWorkspace.title: A pulled workspace links to the synced Collection and updates enabled Skills offline.

mergeOfflineEdits.title: Overlapping offline edits to a connected Draft converge without losing either device’s history.

sendRemovals.title: Sync sends removals made since this Library last synced.

alignIndependentImports.title: Adding the same source on two devices merges into one Collection instead of duplicating it.

retainResolvedVersions.title: Resolving a conflict with --take-remote keeps older local Skill versions in history.

resolveCollectionRemoval.title: Removing a Collection on one device while editing it on another conflicts as one decision.

keepUnrelatedSelections.title: Sync keeps unrelated Registry choices when resolving a local selection conflict.

repeatConflictResolution.title: Retrying after a failed conflict resolution still requires passing --take-remote again.

protectLaterEdits.title: An unresolved earlier sync cannot silently overwrite a later edit.

recordMergedRevision.title: Sync records the Registry revision it merged before uploading local changes.

protectStoredCopies.title: Sync stops if SKIT’s stored Skill copies were modified on disk.

preserveRefusedSync.title: A refused Library sync leaves the saved Library records unchanged.

retryAcceptedChange.title: A failed Library sync can be retried without losing a Registry change already accepted.

rejectPartialDownload.title: A failed download does not save a partial fresh Library.

reuseVerifiedDownload.title: Sync reuses a verified saved download.

keepDeviceSelection.title: Sync keeps this device’s installation choices local.

retainAfterInstallFailure.title: If copying Skills to a harness fails after syncing, the synced Library is kept.

refuseUnusableHarness.title: If a harness skills directory is unusable before sync, sync stops without saving.

protectEditedSkills.title: Sync never overwrites or deletes a Skill folder you edited directly.

respectRepositoryDestinations.title: Sync keeps each repository’s installed Skills at that repository’s destination.

ignoreInactiveEdits.title: Edits left in an uninstalled harness do not block sync.
